title: Payment and Vehicle Exit
overview: Payment changes an OPEN ticket to PAID; a successful gate validation inside the exit window changes it to CLOSED and releases capacity.
preconditions: The ticket exists with OPEN status.
main_flow: The cashier obtains the current quote.
The driver pays the exact amount by cash or card.
The system records payment and marks the ticket PAID.
The exit gate validates the ticket within fifteen minutes.
The system marks the ticket CLOSED and decrements occupancy.

alternative_flows.result: Return the prior result without repeating its side effects.

business_rules: Supported methods are CASH and CARD.
Payment and state transition are atomic.
Exit closure and occupancy decrement are atomic.
